msg: Split the gnomes into two groups - Green+Brown and Pink+Purple. I'd start by pickingonly the green and brown gnomes. They seem to start out much beter than the pink and purple ones. After a while, results for green and brown will diminish, and you will want to swap to the pink and purple gnomes. I think this point is when you start collecting less than 4 mushrooms.Sometimes it seemed neither group was collecting many. When this happens, go a few rounds with one group on low returns, then swap to the other group.
